contexts.text: Shekel = price, or estimation. AC 2959:5, illustrated.
Shekel of holiness, because the price or estimation regards truth and good from Him. Illustrated.
The shekel was twenty gerahs = the estimation of the good of remains.
Therefore the shekel was also a weight according to which the price of gold and silver was estimated.
Shekel = the price or estimation of good and truth.
Half a shekel = the determination of its quantity.
Thirty shekels of silver () = restitution of the injury to the full through truth.
Shekel of holiness = the truth which is of the Lord alone.

The half of a shekel in the shekel of holiness () = all things of truth from good; a half = all; and a shekel = truth from good; because a shekel was a weight of silver and also of gold; and the shekel, regarded in itself as a weight, denotes the quantity; and when it is said the shekel of holiness, it denotes the quantity of truth and good; for these are holy.

Twenty oboli a shekel () = all things of good; for twenty = all things, the remains of good, and what is holy... Hence it is evident why the shekel was of twenty gerahs or oboli, and why it is called the shekel of holiness. Illustrated.
That the shekel was a weight of both silver and gold. Illustrated.
In the shekel of holiness () = the estimation of truth and good as to its quantity and quality.
